use: Albedo atlas UV-mapped onto separate physical grocery props; no shelf photo or flat window backdrop.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a production game texture atlas for labels on actual three-dimensional jars, bottles, tins, paper packets and little shelf cards in an old European grocery shop.
Create one square 2048 x 2048 flat albedo texture, precisely divided into FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 equal SQUARE cells. Every cell is an individual vintage printed grocery label laid perfectly flat, straight-on orthographic. Each cell fills its entire square with its own paper colour, no gaps between cells, no drop shadows, no perspective. Keep lettering and printed border inside a safe 8 percent margin in each square. All sixteen labels need rich small-scale paper fibres, subtle foxing, edge abrasion, ink wear and imperfect old lithographic ink, but still readable large product names. Fine engraved botanical/product illustrations and period serif typography, restrained cream, oxblood red, bottle green, faded indigo, muted mustard, brown ink. Genuine realistic printed surfaces, no painterly look.
Cell contents in reading order, left to right then top to bottom:
Row 1: cream/green OLIVE OIL with olive branch engraving; cream/oxblood BLACKCURRANT with berry engraving; indigo/cream GINGER BEER with ginger engraving; parchment/brown CIDER with apple engraving.
Row 2: ivory/cobalt TEA with tea plant engraving; cream/ochre COFFEE with coffee branch engraving; cream/brown FLOUR with wheat engraving; pale blue/cream SALT with maritime engraving.
Row 3: golden cream/oxblood HONEY with small bee engraving; cream/green PRESERVES with plum engraving; faded yellow/red MUSTARD with mustard flowers; dark oxblood/cream COCOA with cocoa engraving.
Row 4: pale sage/brown SOAP with plain decorative border; faded indigo/cream SARDINES with fish engraving; cream/red MATCHES with decorative sunburst; cream/mustard OATS with oat stalk engraving.
Constraints: exactly a 4 by 4 grid, all labels occupy equal square cells, texture fills all edges. No bottles, jars, containers, shop interiors, shelves, frame mockup, branding, people, watermark, shadow, directional lighting, specular highlights, bevel or baked depth. This is only the ink and aged paper surface to UV-wrap onto 3D geometry.
layout: Four columns and four rows; reading order starts at top left.
